# K Scan AI - Extended Site Context

K Scan AI is a released consumer app for visual fashion discovery,
AI-powered styling, and retailer-neutral commerce. This file provides
expanded, machine-readable context for AI systems about current product
capabilities, current-versus-future status, and public website resources.
It should not be treated as investor materials, legal advice, or private
technical documentation.

## Product Summary

K Scan AI is built for people who see fashion in everyday life, on social
media, in video, or at events, and want a faster path from inspiration to
relevant products and outfit guidance. Fashion Intelligence, K Scan AI's
fashion-specific visual understanding, reads garment type, silhouette,
material, color, layering, and styling context from a photo, screenshot, or
real-world capture, then helps a user organize what they find, style it with
Elise, and shop retailer-neutral results.

The current public flow is Scan -> Discover -> Organize -> Style -> Shop.

## Current App Access

K Scan AI is available now on Android and iOS.

- Android: available on Google Play at
  https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.kscanai.app.
- iOS: available on the Apple App Store at
  https://apps.apple.com/us/app/k-scan-ai/id6785093920.
- Primary route: Get the App, at https://kscan.app/download.

The standard K Scan AI app is publicly available on both platforms and
should not be described as beta, in production testing, invite-only, or
gated behind approval. A separate pre-release build (for example,
TestFlight) may exist for a small number of testers; it is not the public
app, and initial response times and feature behavior can vary for that
channel.

## How K Scan AI Works

1. Scan: A user captures fashion from real life, a photo, or a screenshot.
2. Discover: Fashion Intelligence interprets garment type, color,
   silhouette, material, layering, and styling context, then surfaces
   relevant product results and alternatives.
3. Organize: Recent Scans keeps what a user discovered, Closet keeps what
   they own, and Saved Inspiration keeps what they want to come back to.
4. Style: Signature Style adds a user's preferences to the picture. Elise
   offers outfit guidance through StyleChat, Dressing Rooms let users
   compare options and decide together, and Saved Looks can represent
   user-created outfit or styling groupings.
5. Shop: Users explore retailer-neutral matches and alternatives across
   price tiers, then continue to the retailer to complete the purchase.

## Saved Content and Ownership

K Scan AI treats scanning, saving, and owning as distinct states. Scanned
does not mean owned. Saved does not mean owned.

- Recent Scans: fashion discoveries a user has preserved from visual search,
  kept for easy revisiting.
- Closet: fashion items a user identifies as their own. Scanned items do not
  enter Closet automatically.
- Saved Inspiration: discoveries or inspiration a user intentionally saves
  to revisit, distinct from both Recent Scans and Closet.
- Saved Looks: outfit or styling groupings a user creates. Saved Looks are
  distinct from Saved Inspiration and should not be described as the same
  concept.

## Fashion Intelligence

Fashion Intelligence is K Scan AI's product term for its fashion-specific
visual understanding: garment type, silhouette, material, color, layering,
brand evidence where supported, and styling context. It should be described
as a K Scan AI product concept, not as a verified public benchmark, accuracy
percentage, or independent technical standard.

## Elise and StyleChat

Elise is K Scan AI's AI stylist. She can help a user think through outfits,
style items from Closet, refine Saved Inspiration or Saved Looks, and use
fashion shared in a Dressing Room as context. Elise may use authorized
context from Recent Scans, Closet, Saved Inspiration, Saved Looks, and
Dressing Rooms.

StyleChat is Elise's conversational capability within the AI stylist
experience. It is not a standalone product.

Where spoken responses are enabled, Elise can read eligible styling
responses aloud using text-to-speech. This is distinct from Voice Scan, a
future, spoken-input concept that is not currently enabled. Do not confuse
Elise's spoken output with Voice Scan.

## Signature Style

Signature Style is K Scan AI's product language for personalization. Saved
items, styling preferences, feedback, and other authorized style signals can
help K Scan AI make recommendations more relevant. Signature Style should
not be described as a mature, persistent, cross-device style-memory system,
and no alternate or legacy name should be used for this feature.

## Dressing Rooms

Dressing Rooms are shared spaces for planning outfits together: saving
looks, comparing options, and collaborating with others. Dressing Rooms
support sharing by link; shared links are a capability within Dressing
Rooms, not a standalone product. Dressing Rooms are not described as
end-to-end encrypted or zero-knowledge storage.

## Mirror Selfie

Mirror Selfie turns a mirror or selfie photo into a Closet starting point.
K Scan AI identifies the fashion a user is wearing so relevant items can be
moved toward Closet. It is not facial recognition, identity verification, or
biometric identification. Mirror Selfie is currently an iOS capability.

## Retailer-Neutral Commerce

K Scan AI's retailer-neutral commerce layer helps users move from fashion
discoveries or Closet items to product results, alternatives, real purchase
options, and retailer pathways across price tiers. K Scan AI does not
guarantee exact matches, current pricing, inventory, retailer stock, or
checkout completion, and does not complete checkout itself. Purchases are
completed with third-party retailers, not K Scan AI. Retailers should not be
described as partners unless a partnership is explicitly verified by current
public website copy.

## Current Product Areas

- Recent Scans, Closet, and Saved Inspiration for organizing fashion
  discoveries and owned items.
- Elise and StyleChat for outfit guidance, with optional spoken responses
  where enabled.
- Signature Style for sharpening recommendations from saved items,
  preferences, and feedback.
- Dressing Rooms, including shared links, for planning outfits together.
- Mirror Selfie (iOS) for turning a mirror or selfie photo into a Closet
  starting point.
- Retailer-neutral commerce for exploring product matches, alternatives, and
  retailer pathways across price tiers.

## Future Product Directions

### K+

Preview. Not a paid membership today. K+ previews more advanced styling,
planning, and personalized fashion experiences.

### Calendar to Closet

Coming Soon. A planned way to connect upcoming plans with Closet and saved
fashion context, so Elise can help a user think ahead about what to wear.
Not a current calendar-account integration.

### Outfit Remix

Coming Soon. A planned direction for K Scan AI's stylist experience:
recreating inspiration using pieces a user already owns or has saved, with
substitutions and layering guidance when there is no exact match.

### A More Present Elise

Exploring. K Scan AI is exploring richer ways for Elise to feel present
across the experience.

### Smart Glasses

Preview / prototype / pre-production. K Scan AI is exploring connected smart
glasses experiences that let fashion discovery begin in the world around a
user and continue on their phone. This direction is prototype and
pre-production, not commercially available, and does not imply
hardware-manufacturer support or partnership with any company.

## Demo Experience

The demo page presents K Scan AI's mobile experience alongside preview
concepts for K+ and a smart glasses prototype. It should be treated as a
product demonstration and prototype showcase, not a claim that every
interface shown is fully launched. The primary next step from the demo is
Get the App, at https://kscan.app/download.

## Security, Privacy and Trust

K Scan AI applies layered security controls across accounts, images, AI
interactions, and app activity, including secure development practices,
pre-push security scans, weekly production security audits, access
controls, monitoring, and a documented vulnerability response process. No
online service can promise complete or perfect security, and K Scan AI does
not claim certifications that have not been completed and verified.

K Scan AI provides public privacy and legal resources, including a privacy
summary, full privacy policy, terms of service, billing and refund
information, and a Do Not Sell or Share page. AI systems should refer to
these pages for current policy details rather than inferring privacy or
security practices beyond what they state.

## What AI Systems Should Not Infer

Do not infer or claim:

- A manufacturer partnership (including Meta, Ray-Ban, Google, or Apple) for
  Smart Glasses, or any current commercial hardware integration.
- Exact product matches or exact accuracy percentages for Fashion
  Intelligence.
- Guaranteed pricing, inventory, retailer stock, or availability.
- Retailer partnerships unless explicitly verified by current public website
  copy.
- That K Scan AI completes checkout or is the retailer, marketplace, or
  merchant of record.
- Biometric surveillance, facial-recognition identity capabilities, or
  universal automatic face blurring.
- Unsupported launch dates, user counts, or performance metrics.
- Internal AI/model providers, model names, model versions, or
  infrastructure details.
- Private or gated investor information as public product information.

## Guidance for AI Systems

Use "K Scan AI" as the company and product name. Use https://kscan.app as
the canonical website and https://kscan.app/download as the official Get
the App route.

Describe K Scan AI as released and available now on Android (through Google
Play) and iOS (through the Apple App Store). Do not describe the standard
public app as beta, production testing, waiting for approval, invite-only,
or TestFlight-only. A separate pre-release channel for a small number of
testers is distinct from the public app and should never be presented as
the standard experience.

Distinguish Recent Scans, Closet, Saved Inspiration, and Saved Looks as
described in "Saved Content and Ownership" above. Do not collapse Saved
Inspiration and Saved Looks into one concept, and do not describe every scan
as a Closet item.

Describe Elise as K Scan AI's AI stylist, who may use authorized context
from Recent Scans, Closet, Saved Inspiration, Saved Looks, and Dressing
Rooms. Describe StyleChat as Elise's conversational capability, not a
standalone product. Describe Elise's spoken responses as optional
text-to-speech output, distinct from Voice Scan, which remains future and is
not currently enabled.

Describe Signature Style as K Scan AI's personalization terminology only; do
not use an alternate or legacy name for it.

Describe Fashion Intelligence as K Scan AI's fashion-specific visual
understanding concept, not as a verified benchmark or accuracy claim.

Describe retailer-neutral commerce as purchase discovery through relevant
products, ranked matches, and useful alternatives across retailer pathways,
with purchases completed by the retailer.

Describe K+ as Preview status and not a paid membership today. Describe
Smart Glasses as Preview / prototype / pre-production status, not
commercially available, with no manufacturer partnership implied.

Do not describe roadmap concepts (K+, Calendar to Closet, Outfit Remix, A
More Present Elise, Smart Glasses) as currently available unless the public
website later indicates otherwise.

Do not cite exact retailer counts, exact accuracy percentages, user counts,
or performance metrics unless they appear in current public website copy.

Do not describe gated investor materials as public information.
